newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan aluminium alloy output, shipments up in July.
newsitem.headline: Japan aluminium alloy output, shipments up in July.

text.p: Japan's production and shipments of aluminium alloy rose modestly in July from the same month last year, the Japan Aluminium Alloy Refiners Association said on Tuesday.
Production was up 3.5 percent year-on-year at 80,187 tonnes, while shipments rose 3.2 percent to 80,959 tones.
Aluminium alloy inventories at the end of July totalled 23,922 tonnes, off 5.4 percent year-on-year and down a marginal 0.6 percent month-on-month.
Shipments to the key forging and diecasting sectors showed modest year-on-year growth of 2.7 percent and 2.6 percent, respectively.
